tagShapeMismatches.english: Deep beneath the surface of the world lies the Underdark, a realm of endless labyrinthine tunnels and caverns where the sun never shines. The Underdark is filled with races and creatures too numerous to count or list, and foremost among these are the dark elves—the drow. Hated and feared even by their fellow dwellers in darkness, the drow raid other settlements in the Underdark as well as the surface world, taking prisoners back with them. Rendered {@condition unconscious} with {@item drow poison}, then collared and shackled, these prisoners are eventually sold as slaves or entertainment in the dark elves' subterranean cities.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在世界表面之下深處是幽暗地域，一個由無盡的迷宮般隧道和洞穴組成的領域，那裡太陽永不照耀。幽暗地域充滿了數不勝數的種族和生物，其中最突出的便是黑暗精靈——卓爾。甚至被同為黑暗住民的同伴所憎恨和恐懼，卓爾襲擊幽暗地域的其他聚居地以及地表世界，將階下囚帶回。這些囚犯被{@item 卓爾毒藥}弄得{@condition 昏迷}，然後戴上項圈和鐐銬，最終在黑暗精靈的地下城市中被賣作奴隸或娛樂品。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Any violent conflict draws the attention of the drow guards, who initially order any prisoners to stand down from a fight, threatening them with hand crossbows from outside the gate. If necessary, they shoot prisoners with poisoned crossbow bolts to incapacitate them. (See {@book chapter 8|DMG|8|Poisons} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for information on {@item drow poison}.) The guards let any fight play out for their own amusement as long as the prisoners don't seem likely to actually kill one another.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 任何暴力衝突都會引起卓爾警衛們的注意，他們最初會命令階下囚停止戰鬥，並用牢門外的手弩威脅它們。如有必要，他們會用淬毒弩箭射擊囚犯使其失能。（關於{@item drow poison||卓爾毒藥}的資訊，請參閱{@book 第八章|DMG|8|Poisons}的{@i 城主指南}。）只要囚犯們看起來不太可能真的互相殘殺，警衛們就會讓任何戰鬥繼續下去以供他們自己娛樂。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Each of the chests in the four chambers contains a flask of {@item drow poison} used to treat crossbow bolts. One flask has enough poison to treat 20 bolts. Each chest also contains two changes of clothing, {@dice 2d6} sp, {@dice 1d8} gp, and {@dice 1d4} items from the Trinkets table in chapter 5, "{@book Equipment|PHB|5|Trinkets}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 四個房間中的每個箱子都裝有一瓶用於處理弩箭的{@item 卓爾毒藥}。一瓶毒藥足以處理20支弩箭。每個箱子還包含兩套換洗衣物、{@dice 2d6}銀幣、{@dice 1d8}金幣和來自第五章"{@book 裝備|PHB|5|飾品}"中飾品表的{@dice 1d4}件物品，出自{@i 玩家手冊}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Much of the party's travel through the Underdark is handled abstractly, using the rules and advice in chapter 8, "{@book Adventuring|PHB|8|Travel Pace}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}. The following specific guidelines apply to travel in the Underdark during this adventure.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 隊伍在幽暗地域中的大部分旅行是抽象處理的，使用《{@i 玩家手冊}》第8章"{@book 冒險|PHB|8|旅行步調}"中的規則和建議。在此冒險期間的幽暗地域旅行適用以下具體指導方針。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Unless they obtain a supply of food and water, the adventurers must forage to survive on their journey. Finding sustenance in the Underdark is difficult but not impossible. Characters can gather food and water if the party travels at a normal or slow pace. A foraging character makes a Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check. The DC is typically 15, but might be as high as 20 in some parts of the Underdark. Food and water requirements for characters are described in chapter 8, "{@book Adventuring|PHB|8|Food and Water}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 除非他們獲得食物和水的補給，否則冒險者們必須在旅途中覓食以求生存。在幽暗地域中尋找食物和水是困難的，但並非不可能。如果隊伍以正常或緩慢的速度行進，角色可以收集食物和水。覓食的角色需要進行一次感知（{@skill 求生}）檢定。DC通常為15，但在幽暗地域的某些區域可能高達20。角色對食物和水的需求詳見《{@i 玩家手冊}》第8章"{@book 冒險|PHB|8|糧食與水}"。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A Nilhogg's nose is a small mushroom that grants any creature that eats it advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks based on smell for {@dice 1d4} hours. However, the creature suffers disadvantage on saving throws against effects based on smell for the same amount of time.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 尼爾霍格的鼻子是一種小蘑菇，任何吃掉它的生物在接下來的{@dice 1d4}小時內，基於嗅覺的感知（{@skill 察覺}）檢定上獲得優勢。然而，在同一時間內，該生物在對抗基於嗅覺的效果的豁免檢定上會受到劣勢。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The drow party consists of Ilvara ({@creature drow priestess of Lolth}), the {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors} Jorlan and Shoor, and the junior priestess {@creature Asha Vandree|OotA} (use the {@creature priest} stat block in the {@i Monster Manual}, but add the Fey Ancestry, Innate Spellcasting, and Sunlight Sensitivity features of the {@creature drow} stat block). The hunting party also includes four {@creature drow} warriors who serve as forward scouts. If any of the drow NPCs did not survive chapter 1, replace them with newly arrived reinforcements from Menzoberranzan under the command of Ilvara, or another priestess of her caliber.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 卓爾小隊由伊爾瓦拉（{@creature 卓爾羅絲女祭司}）、兩名{@creature 卓爾精英武者||卓爾精英武者}喬蘭和肖爾，以及初級女祭司{@creature 阿莎·範德里|OotA}（使用{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的{@creature 祭司}屬性塊，但新增{@creature 卓爾}屬性塊中的妖精血脈、天生施法和陽光敏感受性特性）組成。狩獵隊還包括四名作為前方偵察兵的{@creature 卓爾}戰士。如果任何卓爾NPC在第一章中未能倖存，用新到來的來自魔索布萊城的由伊爾瓦拉或其他同等級女祭司指揮的增援部隊替換他們。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The adventurers come across a small ruin hidden in the Underdark. This might be the creation of a subterranean race or a surface ruin that collapsed and sank long ago. If the characters search the ruins, there is a 50 percent chance of them finding {@dice 1d4} trinkets (see chapter 5, "{@book Equipment|PHB|5|Trinkets}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}). Roll on the Trinkets table or choose appropriate ones.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 冒險者發現幽暗地域中隱藏的一小片廢墟。這可能是地下種族的建築，也可能是很久以前坍塌並沉入地下的地表遺跡。角色若搜尋廢墟，有50%的機率找到{@dice 1d4}件小飾物（見{@i 玩家手冊}第5章「{@book 裝備|PHB|5|Trinkets}」）。在小飾物表上擲骰，或選擇合適的物品。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As the adventurers pass through a small cavern, they encounter a patch of slime or mold. Roll a {@dice d6} and consult the table to determine what type of slime or mold is present (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for details on these threats).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當冒險者們穿過一個小洞穴時，他們遇到了一片粘液或黴菌。擲一個{@dice d6}並參考表格來確定存在的粘液或黴菌型別（詳見{@i 城主指南}第5章中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|地城危害物}"，瞭解這些威脅的詳細資訊）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A monster hoard containing {@dice 2d6} 50 gp gems and one or more random magic items (roll {@dice 1d4} times on Magic Item Table C in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Random Treasure} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide})
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個怪物財寶包含{@dice 2d6}個50金幣的寶石以及一個或多個隨機魔法物品（在{@book 第七章|DMG|7|隨機寶藏}中的魔法物品表C上擲{@dice 1d4}次，選自{@i 城主指南}）

tagShapeMismatches.english: The party encounters a creature driven insane by the influence of the demon lords. Roll a {@dice d4} and consult the table to determine what appears. Then roll on the {@table Indefinite Madness} table in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} to determine the nature of the creature's madness. If cured of its madness, the creature behaves in accordance with its alignment.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 隊伍遇到一個被惡魔領主影響而瘋狂的生物。擲一顆{@dice d4}並參考表格來確定出現的情況。然後在{@i 城主指南}第8章的{@table 永久性瘋狂}表格上擲骰，以確定該生物瘋狂的性質。如果治癒了其瘋狂，該生物將按照其陣營行動。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A random magic item (roll once on Magic Item Table A in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Random Treasure} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide})
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個隨機魔法物品（可在{@i 城主指南}的{@book 第七章|DMG|7|隨機寶藏}中的魔法物品表A上擲骰一次）

tagShapeMismatches.english: A lit torch or its equivalent uses up air as a character does. Briefer but hotter magical effects consume 1 hour of air per die of fire damage per round. For example, a {@spell fireball} spell that deals {@dice 8d6} fire damage consumes 8 hours of air, while a {@spell fire bolt} that deals {@dice 1d10} fire damage consumes 1 hour of air per use.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 點燃的火把或其等效物會像角色一樣消耗空氣。短暫但更熱的魔法效果每輪消耗等同於火傷害骰數的小時數。例如，造成{@dice 8d6}火傷害的{@spell 火球術}法術會消耗8小時的空氣，而造成{@dice 1d10}火傷害的{@spell 火焰箭}法術每次使用會消耗1小時的空氣。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Most craft navigating the waters of the Darklake are zurkhwood vessels piloted by the kuo-tua or the duergar. These boats are equivalent to keelboats (see the {@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles} table in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在黑湖水域航行的船隻大多是由寇濤或灰矮人駕駛的祖克木船。這些船隻等同於龍骨船（參見{@i 城主指南}第5章中的{@table 擁有一艘船; 空中與水上載具||空中與水上載具}表格）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The home of the archpriest contains a closet full of "offerings" taken from less fortunate travelers or culled from the depths of the lake. This includes 500 cp, 2,000 sp, 150 gp, 27 pp, a strand of matched pearls worth 1,000 gp total, two {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing}, a {@item potion of water breathing}, and a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell light}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 大祭司的家中有一個裝滿從不太幸運的旅行者那裡拿走的"供品"的壁櫥，或者是從湖底深處收集的。這包括500枚銅幣，2000枚銀幣，150枚金幣，27枚鉑金幣，一串價值總計1000金幣的匹配珍珠，兩瓶{@item 治療藥水||治療藥水}，一瓶{@item 水下呼吸藥水}，以及一張{@spell 光亮術}的{@item 法術卷軸}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: An {@condition invisible} {@spell wall of force} stands between the Deepking's dais and the characters. Whether the Deepking is of a mind to fight the demon lords is up to you, although like many other duergar in the city, {@creature Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V|OotA|Horgar Steelshadow V} has been touched by the demon lords' madness. Roll on the Indefinite Madness table in {@table indefinite madness||chapter 8} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} to determine Horgar's flaw.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一道{@condition invisible}的{@spell wall of force}隔開深王的高臺與角色們。深王是否願意對抗惡魔領主，由你決定；不過，如同城中的許多灰矮人，{@creature Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V|OotA|霍加·鋼影五世}也受到惡魔領主的瘋狂影響。在{@book 城主指南|DMG}的{@table indefinite madness||第8章}中擲永久性瘋狂表，決定霍加的缺點。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters approach a section of Blingdenstone in horrible disrepair. If they explore the area, roll a {@dice d6} and consult the Dungeon Hazards table to determine what the characters encounter. See "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for more information on each hazard.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們來到了布林登石城一處破敗不堪的區域。如果他們探索這片區域，擲一個{@dice d6}並參考地城災害表以確定他們遭遇的情況。更多關於每種災害的資訊，請參閱{@i 城主指南}第五章中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|地城危害物}"。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The trapped svirfneblin is named {@creature Mev Flintknapper|OotA} (use the {@creature veteran} statistics in the {@i Monster Manual}, but also give Mev the Stone Camouflage, Gnome Cunning, and Innate Spellcasting features of a {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome}). He has already taken 10 acid damage and takes another 21 ({@dice 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns until pulled free with a successful {@dc 12} Strength check. The attempt requires an action, and any creature making the attempt takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) acid damage is it reaches into the cube.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 被困的深地侏儒名叫{@creature Mev Flintknapper|OotA|梅夫·弗林特納普}（使用{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的{@creature veteran||老兵}資料，但梅夫還擁有{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}的石頭偽裝、侏儒狡詐和天生施法能力）。他已經受到了10點酸蝕傷害，並且在立方體每回合開始時還會受到21點（{@dice 6d6}）酸蝕傷害，直到透過一個成功的{@dc 12}力量檢定將他拉出來。這個嘗試需要一個動作，任何進行嘗試的生物在將手伸入立方體時會受到10點（{@dice 3d6}）酸蝕傷害。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The Stoneheart Enclave agreed to join the Diggermattock effort to resettle Blingdenstone in exchange for help reclaiming this temple known as the Ruby in the Rough. The temple is dedicated to Segojan Earthcaller, the svirfneblin god of deep earth and nature. The rituals and day-to-day duties of the temple are overseen by a deep gnome named {@creature Glyphic Shroomlight|OotA}, a nervous young novice doing his best in a situation requiring a much older and more experienced cleric (use the {@creature acolyte} statistics in the {@i Monster Manual}, but also give Glyphic the Stone Camouflage, Gnome Cunning, and Innate Spellcasting features of a {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 石心會同意加入迪格瑪托克家族重新定居布林德斯頓的行動，以換取協助奪回這座被稱為"粗獷的紅寶石"的廟宇。這座廟宇供奉著地底侏儒的深土與自然之神塞高詹·喚地者。廟宇的儀式和日常職責由一位名叫{@creature 符文蘑菇燈|OotA}的地底侏儒監督，他是一個緊張的青年新手，在需要更年長、更有經驗的牧師的情況下盡力而為（使用{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的{@creature 侍僧}具體數值，但同時也賦予格利菲克{@creature 地底侏儒（斯涅布力）||地底侏儒}的岩石偽裝、狡黠和天生施法特性）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Gurnik Tapfinger, head priest of Callarduran Smoothhands in the Stoneheart Enclave, approaches the characters if they show any interest in the Speaking Stones (use the {@creature priest} statistics in the {@i Monster Manual}, but also give Gurnik the Stone Camouflage, Gnome Cunning, and Innate Spellcasting features of a {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome}). He asks them to undertake a task in a closed-off area of the old city known as Rockblight, where the temple of his god stands desecrated. If the characters agree, he gives them a ruby {@item spell gem|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix B|OotA|18}) containing the {@spell hallow} spell and asks them to place the gem in the Steadfast Stone's menhir (see area 22).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 斯通哈特要塞中卡拉杜蘭·順滑之手的大祭司古爾尼克·塔普芬格，如果角色們對言石表現出任何興趣，他就會接近他們（使用{@creature 祭司}的資料，見{@i 怪物圖鑑}，但同時賦予古爾尼克石之偽裝、侏儒狡詐和一個{@creature 地底侏儒（斯涅布力）||地底侏儒}的先天施法特性）。他請求他們在舊城的一個封閉區域——被稱為石疫的地方——執行一項任務，那裡他神祇的神廟已被褻瀆。如果角色們同意，他會給他們一顆包含{@spell 聖居}的紅寶石{@item 法術寶石|OotA}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|OotA|18}），並要求他們將寶石放置在堅石之柱的巨石柱中（見區域 22）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The wererats have rigged traps throughout the warrens. All wererats know where the traps are and how to avoid them. The traps are marked with russet squares on the map. The first time a party member enters one of these areas, he or she triggers a trap unless the trap has been detected and disarmed. Roll a {@dice d6} to determine the type of trap: 1–2, spiked pit (10 feet deep and lined with zurkhwood spikes); 3–4, collapsing roof; or 5–6, poison darts. See "{@book Sample Traps|DMG|5|Sample Traps}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for information on each trap.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 鼠人在地道中設定了陷阱。所有鼠人都知道陷阱的位置以及如何避開它們。陷阱在地圖上用赤褐色的方塊標記。第一次有隊員進入這些區域時，除非陷阱被探測並解除，否則他或她將觸發陷阱。擲一枚{@dice d6}來確定陷阱的型別：1-2，尖刺陷坑（深10尺，底部佈滿祖克木尖刺）；3-4，坍塌的屋頂；或5-6，毒箭。關於每個陷阱的詳細資訊，請參閱{@i 城主指南}第五章中的"{@book 陷阱範例|DMG|5|陷阱範例}"。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The figure dipping his feet in the water is {@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA}, a high elf druid and member of the Emerald Enclave. Use the {@creature druid} statistics in the {@i Monster Manual} to represent him, with the following modifications:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 將腳浸入水中的身影是{@creature 斯拉迪斯·瓦迪爾|OotA}，一名高等精靈德魯伊，也是翡翠密會的一員。使用{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的{@creature 德魯伊}屬性值來代表他，並做以下修改：

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Sladis Vadir|OotA} has always felt a strange attraction to the Underdark, but the demonic incursion has broken his sanity. He kills and eats other humanoids he encounters or, as he calls it, "culls the herd to maintain the natural order." This is considered a form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 斯拉迪斯·瓦迪爾|OotA}一直對幽暗地域有一種奇特的吸引力，但惡魔的入侵使他失去了理智。他會殺死並吃掉他遇到的其他類人生物，或者，用他的話來說，"透過剔除弱者來維持自然秩序。"這被認為是一種永久性瘋狂的表現（參見{@i 城主指南}第8章中的"{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|瘋狂}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The tent belongs to the figure inside it: a female human named {@creature Rystia Zav|OotA}. Rystia is a chaotic good Harper {@creature spy} from Nesmé who descended into the Underdark two years ago to find Mantol-Derith and infiltrate the Zhentarim enclave there. She got lost in the depths and has no idea how close she's come to finding what she's been looking for. She also has no idea how to get to the surface. Fear, loneliness, and the demonic incursion have driven her mad. She now believes that everyone she encounters is out to kill her. This is considered a form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這個帳篷屬於裡面的一個人物：一位名叫{@creature 瑞斯蒂亞·扎夫|OotA}的女性人類。瑞絲蒂亞是一位混亂善良的豎琴手{@creature 間諜}，來自涅斯梅。兩年前她深入幽暗地域尋找曼託爾-德里特並滲透那裡的散塔林會據點。她在深處迷了路，完全不知道她已經離她一直在尋找的東西有多近。她也不知道如何返回地表。恐懼、孤獨以及惡魔的入侵讓她發瘋了。她現在認為她遇到的每個人都想殺死她。這被視為一種不確定的瘋狂形式（見{@i 城主指南}第8章中的"{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|瘋狂}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The svirfneblin and duergar markets are clustered on the east side of the trench. Most of their tents and stalls have been knocked over, and various goods (see "Treasure") are strewn upon the cavern floor amid the slaughtered corpses of giant lizards and steeders. Characters approaching the market see two enlarged {@creature duergar} chasing a pair of {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnomes} who have cast {@spell blur} spells on themselves. A third unarmed {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome} is hiding in plain sight under the wreckage of a zurkhwood stall. He has a pale leather bag tucked under one arm.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 斯維爾弗涅布林和杜爾加市場聚集在溝壑的東側。他們的大部分帳篷和攤位已被掀翻，各種貨物（見"寶藏"）散落在地洞的地面上，周圍是巨蜥和斯提德的屍體。接近市場的角色會看到兩個巨大的{@creature 灰矮人}正在追逐一對對自己施放了{@spell 朦朧術}的{@creature 地底侏儒（斯涅布力）||地底侏儒}。第三個手無寸鐵的{@creature 地底侏儒（斯涅布力）||地底侏儒}正躲在一個佐克木攤位的廢墟下，幾乎無處可藏。他的腋下夾著一個蒼白的皮革袋子。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Each storage building contains {@dice 2d6} crystal vials of exotic perfume worth 100 gp each, {@dice 3d6} crystal bottles of distilled beverages worth 25 gp each, {@dice 1d4} magic items (determined by rolling on Magic Item Table A in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Treasure Tables} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}), and {@dice 2d6} vials of carrion crawler mucus (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). Characters also find {@dice 1d10 × 10} pounds of food and {@dice 1d10 × 5} gallons of water stored in each building.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 每座倉庫都有{@dice 2d6}瓶珍奇香水，裝在水晶小瓶中，每瓶價值100金幣；{@dice 3d6}瓶以水晶瓶盛裝的蒸餾飲品，每瓶價值25金幣；{@dice 1d4}件魔法物品（擲{@i 城主指南}{@book 第7章|DMG|7|Treasure Tables}的魔法物品表A決定）；以及{@dice 2d6}瓶食腐蟲黏液（見{@i 城主指南}第8章的「{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}」）。角色也能在每座倉庫中找到{@dice 1d10 × 10}磅食物與{@dice 1d10 × 5}加侖的水。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When dealing with combat between large groups of creatures—either the adventurers' allies or their foes—you might wish to use the guidelines under "{@book Handling Mobs|DMG|8|Handling Mobs}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}. In some cases, you can simply match forces on one side with those on the other and assume they neutralize each other—for example, a band of shield dwarves fighting for the adventurers against a band of orcs. During such combat, the force on the losing side is wiped out while the winning force suffers a few casualties—anywhere from 10 to 50 percent—based on how difficult you judge the combat was for them.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你處理一大群生物之間的戰鬥時——無論是冒險者的盟友還是敵人——你可能會希望使用{@i 城主指南}第8章中的"{@book 處理亂鬥|DMG|8|處理亂鬥}"指南。在某些情況下，你可以簡單地讓一方的力量與另一方的力量相匹配，並假設他們相互中和——例如，一隊為冒險者而戰的盾矮人與一隊獸人戰鬥。在這種戰鬥中，失敗的一方會被殲滅，而勝利的一方則會遭受一些傷亡——從10%到50%不等——這取決於你認為戰鬥對他們來說有多困難。

tagShapeMismatches.english: While traveling as part of a larger group, the characters have an easier time navigating their way through the Underdark than they did during their initial escape. The characters' own experience, plus that of their followers, along with maps and other information they might have acquired in Gauntlgrym or elsewhere, give all members of the expanded party advantage on any Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to avoid becoming lost (see chapter 5, "{@book Adventure Environments|DMG|5|Becoming Lost}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 作為一大群體的一部分旅行時，角色們在地下國度中導航比他們最初逃亡時更容易。角色們自身的經驗，加上他們追隨者的經驗，以及他們在崗特爾格里姆或其他地方獲得的地圖和其他資訊，使得擴大後的隊伍的所有成員在避免迷路的感知（{@skill 求生}）檢定上具有優勢（參見{@i 城主指南}第5章"{@book 冒險環境|DMG|5|迷路}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the expeditionary force needs to supplement or replace supplies while traveling, the amounts that characters are able to find become more important with a larger group to support. See "{@book Foraging|DMG|5|Foraging}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}, as well as the guidelines in {@area chapter 2|067|x} of this adventure.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果遠徵軍在旅途中需要補充或替換物資，那麼在支援更大團隊的情況下，角色能夠找到的物資數量就變得更加重要。請參閱{@i 城主指南}第五章中的"{@book 覓食|DMG|5|覓食}"以及本冒險{@area 第二章|067|x}中的指導方針。

tagShapeMismatches.english: For the rules on madness, see {@area chapter 2|063|x} of this adventure and chapter 8, "{@book Running the Game|DMG|8|Madness}," in the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 有關瘋狂規則的詳細內容，請參見本冒險的{@area 第二章|063|x}以及{@i 城主指南}中的第8章"{@book 運作遊戲|DMG|8|瘋狂}"。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A small group of characters scouting can sneak up on {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} with a successful {@dc 10} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. Any characters who observe the basilisk can note that it keeps its eyes downcast, as if consciously trying to control its petrifying gaze. When {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} becomes aware of the characters, he calls them over, speaking in all the languages he knows until he determines that the characters understand Common.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一小隊角色偵察時，如果透過了 {@dc 10} 的群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，可以悄悄接近 {@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾}。任何觀察石化蜥蜴的角色都會注意到它一直低垂著眼睛，彷彿有意識地試圖控制其石化凝視。當 {@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾} 意識到角色的存在時，他會召喚他們過來，用他所知道的所有語言說話，直到他確定角色們理解了通用語。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The eastern half of this cavern floor is covered in webs stretching up to the ceiling. See "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for rules about webs. Eight {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders} lurk in the nest, minus any killed elsewhere in the nursery.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 洞穴地板的東半部分被延伸至天花板的蛛網覆蓋。有關蛛網的規則，請參見{@i 城主指南}第5章中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|地城危害物}"。八隻{@creature 巨蜘蛛||巨蜘蛛}潛伏在巢穴中，減去在幼崽區其他地方被殺死的數量。

tagShapeMismatches.english: He carries a {@item potion of healing}, a {@item potion of poison}, and a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell globe of invulnerability}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 他攜帶著一瓶{@item 治療藥水}，一瓶{@item 劇毒藥水}，以及一張包含{@spell 法術無效結界}的{@item 法術卷軸}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: This cloister of {@creature Flumph||flumphs} feeds on the psychic energy they detect from a nearby {@creature mind flayer} that has enslaved {@dice 2d4} {@creature Quaggoth||quaggoths}. The flumphs warn adventurers who communicate with them about the nearby threats, but it is up to the characters whether they wish to engage those threats.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這個{@creature 呋嚕||呋嚕}的修道院以它們從附近一個奴役了{@dice 2d4}個{@creature 幽邃熊怪||幽邃熊怪們}的{@creature 奪心魔}那裡探測到的心靈能量為食。呋嚕警告與它們交流的冒險者有關附近威脅的事情，但是否要應對這些威脅取決於角色們自己。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The {@creature Shrieker||shriekers} sound off when {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} or a creature is within 30 feet of them. Their shrieking has a 75 percent chance of attracting other monsters, in which case roll again on the Labyrinth Encounters table, treating another shrieker encounter as "no encounter."
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當{@quickref 視野與光照||2||明亮光照}或一個生物在30尺內時，{@creature 尖叫菌||尖叫菌}會發出聲音。它們的尖叫聲有75%的機率吸引其他怪物，在這種情況下，在迷宮遭遇表格上重新擲骰，將另一次尖叫菌遭遇視為"無遭遇"。

tagShapeMismatches.english: No ordinary structure, the tower is a {@item Daern's instant fortress} (see chapter 7, "{@book Treasure|DMG|7}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). Made entirely of adamantine, the two-story tower has remained sealed since its last owner retreated inside and locked the door behind her—but not before a pair of shadow demons slipped in as well. The demons killed the owner and left her remains on the first floor. The tower can't be tipped over or otherwise moved from its position, and the arrow slits on each level are too narrow for anything bigger than a Tiny creature to squeeze through.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這並非普通的建築，這座塔是一件{@item 迪恩的摺疊要塞}（參見{@i 城主指南}第七章"{@book 寶藏|DMG|7}"）。這座兩層塔完全由精金打造，自從它的最後一位主人退入其中並鎖上門後，塔就保持封閉狀態——但在此之前，一對影魔也悄悄溜了進去。影魔殺死了主人，並將她的遺骸留在了一樓。這座塔無法被推倒或以其他方式從其位置移動，且每層的箭縫過於狹窄，任何比微型生物更大的東西都無法擠過。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If a creature falls from the Maze Engine, another creature adjacent to the falling creature and hanging onto one of the engine's bands can attempt to use a free hand to grab the falling creature, doing so with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw. A creature saved in this manner can use its action to try to climb back onto the engine, doing so with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. If the check fails and the creature's weight exceeds the carrying capacity of the creature that grabbed it (see "{@book Lifting and Carrying|PHB|7|Lifting and Carrying}" in chapter 7 of the {@i Player's Handbook}), the creature grabbing it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength check at the start of its next turn or lose its grip on the fallen creature, which then plunges into the magma.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果一個生物從迷宮引擎上跌落，另一個鄰近跌落生物並抓住引擎某一帶的生物可以嘗試用一隻空手抓住跌落生物，這需要一個成功的 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免。以這種方式被救起的生物可以使用其動作嘗試攀爬回引擎，這需要一個成功的 {@dc 13} 力量（{@skill 運動}）檢定。如果檢定失敗並且生物的體重超過了抓住它的生物的承載能力（參見 {@i 玩家手冊} 第七章中的 "{@book 抬舉與載重|PHB|7|抬舉與載重}"），抓住它的生物必須在其下一回合開始時成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 力量檢定，否則失去對跌落生物的抓握，後者將墜入巖漿中。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When using the generic stat blocks in {@book appendix B|MM|2} of the {@i Monster Manual} to represent drow NPCs, assume that the drow are neutral evil and speak Elvish and Undercommon. Also give those NPCs the following additional features.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當使用{@i 怪物圖鑑}中 {@book 附錄 B|MM|2} 的通用屬性表來代表卓爾 NPC 時，假設卓爾是中立邪惡且會說精靈語和地底通用語。此外，賦予這些 NPC 以下額外特徵。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A hidden cave containing {@dice 4d8} {@creature Goblin||goblins} and a {@creature goblin} boss, who will trade a magic item in its possession for the equivalent of 30 days of rations (to determine the item, roll once on Magic Item Table C in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Random Treasure} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide})
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個隱藏的洞穴，裡面藏有 {@dice 4d8} 只 {@creature 地精||地精} 和一名 {@creature 地精} 首領，它會用自己持有的一件魔法物品換取相當於 30 天口糧的物資（要確定該物品，請在 {@i 城主指南} 的 {@book 第七章|DMG|7|隨機寶藏} 中的魔法物品表 C 上進行一次擲骰）

tagShapeMismatches.english: The {@creature drow noble|OotA} offers no reward to his or her rescuers and chastises the drow patrol for not arriving sooner. If the characters demand a reward, the noble frowns and gives them an insignia bearing the mark of his or her house, then instructs the characters to visit the noble's estate "when the light of Narbondel reaches its zenith" to receive their "reward." If the characters visit the noble's estate in Narbondellyn at the appointed time, they are set upon by the house guards, who have orders to eliminate them and dispose of the remains (see "{@area Narbondellyn|52e|x}" for more information on {@creature drow noble|OotA} estates).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這個{@creature 卓爾貴族|OotA}對他的或她的救援者不提供任何獎勵，並因為巡邏隊沒有及時到達而斥責黑暗精靈巡邏隊。如果角色們要求獎勵，貴族皺眉並給了他們一個帶有他或她家族標誌的徽章，然後指示角色們在"納邦德爾的光輝達到頂點時"訪問貴族的莊園以領取他們的"獎勵"。如果角色們在指定的時間去納邦德爾林拜訪貴族的莊園，他們將遭到家兵的襲擊，這些家兵接到命令要消滅他們並處理掉屍體（有關{@creature 卓爾貴族|OotA}莊園的更多資訊，請見"{@area 納邦德爾林|52e|x}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The newest of the city's large clefts, Westrift swallowed up three drow houses and a score of lesser dwellings when it opened its yawning maw three centuries ago. In more recent years, the rift has become home to hundreds of giant arachnids, which have filled much of the cleft with their webs and nests—to the extent that anyone falling into the rift has a 75 percent chance of being caught in a web, taking no damage from the fall but attracting {@dice 1d4 + 1} hungry {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders}. See "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for rules on escaping webs.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這座城市最新的巨大裂縫——西裂痕，在三個世紀前張開它那飢渴的大口時，吞噬了三個卓爾家族和二十多處較小的住所。近年來，裂縫已成為數百隻巨型蛛形生物的家園，它們用蛛網和巢穴填滿了大部分裂縫——以至於任何落入裂縫的人有75%的機率被蛛網困住，雖然不會因墜落而受傷，但會引來{@dice 1d4 + 1}只飢餓的{@creature 巨蜘蛛||巨蜘蛛}。有關逃脫蛛網的規則，請參閱{@i 城主指南}第5章中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|地城危害物}"。

tagShapeMismatches.english: One party member (determined randomly) steps on a pit of soft mold hidden beneath a thin carpet of moss, and sinks into it. The effect is identical to that of quicksand (see chapter 5, "{@book Adventure Environments|DMG|5|Quicksand}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一名隊伍成員（隨機決定）踩到了隱藏在薄薄苔蘚層下的柔軟黴菌坑，並陷入其中。效果與流沙相同（參見{@i 城主指南}第5章，"{@book 冒險環境|DMG|5|流沙}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: In addition to (or instead of) providing information to the adventurers, the last connection to the surviving Araumycos can bestow a {@reward charm of heroism} to all the player characters (see "{@book Other Rewards|DMG|7|Other Rewards}" in chapter 7 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 除了（或代替）向冒險者們提供訊息外，與倖存的阿勞麥柯的最後聯絡可以授予所有玩家角色一個{@reward 英勇護咒}（參見{@i 城主指南}第七章中的"{@book 其他獎勵|DMG|7|其他獎勵}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Additionally, the thirteen timmask mushrooms on the list of required components that Vizeran needs to create his {@i dark heart} talisman (see {@area chapter 12|41b|x}) can be found in the aftermath of the failed wedding ceremony, sprouting in locations touched by Zuggtmoy or Juiblex.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 此外，Vizeran需要的十三個時鐘菌（見{@area 第十二章|41b|x}）來創造他的'{@i 黑暗之心}'護身符的必需成分列表，可以在失敗的婚禮儀式之後找到，在被祖格莫伊或朱庇萊克斯觸及的地方生長。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Players should never have to think about sacrificing their characters, but you should be prepared for the possibility of one or more of the heroes giving up their lives in order to defeat the evil that has arisen in the Underdark. It's up to you how to handle such a high-stakes event, but consider treating it as an extreme variation of "{@book Success at a Cost|DMG|8|Resolution and Consequences}" from chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}. At the very least, a player deliberately sacrificing his or her character's life in a final, selfless heroic effort—the antithesis of the selfishness and evil of the Abyss—should grant all the character's allies inspiration. The sacrifice might not be enough to win the day on its own, but it can help turn the tide.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 玩家們不應該被迫考慮犧牲他們的角色，但你應該為一兩位或多位英雄在擊敗幽暗地域中崛起的邪惡時獻出生命的可能性做好準備。如何應對這種高風險事件取決於你，但可以考慮將其視為{@i 城主指南}第8章中"{@book 有代價的成功|DMG|8|決定與後果}"的極端變體。至少，當玩家故意在最終的無私英雄行為中犧牲其角色的生命時——這是無底深淵的自私和邪惡的對立面——應該給予所有該角色的盟友激勵。犧牲本身可能不足以贏得勝利，但它可以幫助扭轉局勢。

numericDifferences.english: A hand crossbow bolt coated with {@item drow poison} (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide})
numericDifferences.localized: 一支塗有{@item drow poison||卓爾毒藥}的手弩弩矢（參見{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}，出自{@i 城主指南}第八章）

numericDifferences.english: The dense webs of giant spiders kept by the drow conceal the outpost from below. A creature falling into the webs becomes {@condition restrained}. As an action, a {@condition restrained} creature can attempt a {@dc 12} Strength check to break free from the webs. The webs can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10, 15 hp per 10-foot section, vulnerability to fire, and immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage). Each foot of movement in the webs costs 1 extra foot, and any creature other than a spider that enters the webs or starts its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength or Dexterity check to avoid becoming {@condition restrained}. Any movement in the webs attracts the attention of the giant spiders, which attack and feed on trapped creatures.
numericDifferences.localized: 卓爾飼養的巨型蜘蛛密集的蛛網從下方遮蔽了前哨站。掉入蛛網的生物會被{@condition restrained||束縛}。作為一個動作，被{@condition restrained||束縛}的生物可以嘗試進行一次{@dc 12}的力量檢定以掙脫蛛網。蛛網也可以被攻擊並摧毀（AC 10，每10尺部分的生命值為15，對火傷害易傷，對鈍擊、毒素和心靈傷害免疫）。在蛛網中每移動一尺需要額外消耗一尺的移動力，任何非蜘蛛的生物進入蛛網或在其回合開始時位於蛛網中，必須成功透過一次{@dc 12}的力量或敏捷檢定，以避免被{@condition restrained||束縛}。在蛛網中的任何移動都會引起巨型蜘蛛的注意，它們會攻擊並捕食被困的生物。

numericDifferences.english: Stone steps lead from the watch post to a 1-foot-thick platform of zurkhwood (see "{@adventure Fungi of the Underdark|OotA|0|Fungi of the Underdark}" earlier in chapter 2) extending between two of the hanging towers and into three adjoining caverns.
numericDifferences.localized: 石階從瞭望塔通向一個1尺厚的扎克木平臺（見第二章前面"{@adventure 幽暗地域的真菌|OotA|0|Fungi of the Underdark}"），它延伸在兩座懸掛塔樓之間，並通向三個相鄰的洞穴。

numericDifferences.english: Each of the six chests in each barracks contains a flask of {@item drow poison} used to treat crossbow bolts (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). One flask has enough poison to treat 20 bolts. Each chest also contains two sets of clothing and {@dice 1d4} items from the {@book Trinkets|PHB|5|Trinkets} table in chapter 5 of the {@i Player's Handbook}.
numericDifferences.localized: 每個軍營中的六個寶箱各含有一個用於處理弩矢的{@item drow poison||卓爾毒藥}扁瓶（參見{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}於{@i 城主指南}第八章）。一個扁瓶有足夠處理20支弩箭的毒藥。每個箱子還包含兩套衣物和{@dice 1d4}件來自{@book 飾品|PHB|5|Trinkets}表格的物品（見{@i 玩家手冊}第五章）。

numericDifferences.english: Each of the chests in the four chambers contains a flask of {@item drow poison} used to treat crossbow bolts. One flask has enough poison to treat 20 bolts. Each chest also contains two changes of clothing, {@dice 2d6} sp, {@dice 1d8} gp, and {@dice 1d4} items from the Trinkets table in chapter 5, "{@book Equipment|PHB|5|Trinkets}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}.
numericDifferences.localized: 四個房間中的每個箱子都裝有一瓶用於處理弩箭的{@item drow poison||卓爾毒藥}。一瓶毒藥足以處理20支弩箭。每個箱子還包含兩套換洗衣物、{@dice 2d6}銀幣、{@dice 1d8}金幣和來自第五章"{@book 裝備|PHB|5|Trinkets}"中飾品表的{@dice 1d4}件物品，出自{@i 玩家手冊}。

numericDifferences.english: The chest is locked, and Ilvara keeps the key in a hidden pocket on the inside of her belt. The lock is trapped with a poison needle tipped with {@item drow poison} (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}), which is activated if any attempt is made to open the lock without the proper key. The victim takes 1 piercing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also {@condition unconscious} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. A successful {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check reveals the trap. A character using thieves' tools can make a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check to disarm it. Picking the lock requires thieves' tools and another successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check.
numericDifferences.localized: 箱子被鎖上了，且伊爾瓦拉將鑰匙藏在她腰帶內側的隱藏口袋中。鎖上裝有塗有{@item drow poison||卓爾毒藥}（見{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}，位於{@i 城主指南}第八章）的毒針陷阱，如果沒有正確的鑰匙嘗試開鎖就會觸發。受害者受到1穿刺傷害且必須成功透過{@dc 13}的體質豁免檢定否則會陷入{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態1小時。如果豁免檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，目標還會在{@condition poisoned||中毒}的同時陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態。成功的{@dc 20}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定可以發現這個陷阱。使用盜賊工具的角色可以嘗試成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定來解除它。撬開鎖需要盜賊工具和另一個成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定。

numericDifferences.english: Whichever route the characters take, chapter 2 covers their passage through the Underdark toward their eventual destination.
numericDifferences.localized: 無論角色選擇哪條路線，第二章涵蓋了他們穿越地下世界前往最終目的地的過程。

numericDifferences.english: Areas suffused with {@i faerzress} have become tainted by the chaos of the demon lords. When a spell is cast in a {@i faerzress}-suffused area, the caster rolls a {@dice d20}. On a roll of 1, the spell has an additional effect, determined by rolling on the Wild Magic Surge table in chapter 3, "{@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB|Classes}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}.
numericDifferences.localized: 被{@i 費爾茲瑞斯}滲透的區域已被惡魔領主的混沌所汙染。當在受{@i 費爾茲瑞斯}影響的區域施法時，施法者需投擲一個{@dice d20}。若結果為1，該法術將產生額外效果，具體效果透過第三章"{@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB|狂野魔法浪涌}"中的狂野魔法爆發表決定，該表位於{@i 玩家手冊}中。

numericDifferences.english: A one- to two-foot-tall mushroom with a combustible cap, a single torchstalk burns for 24 hours once lit. There is a 1-in-6 chance that a torchstalk explodes when lit, bursting into a cloud of fiery spores. Creatures within 10 feet of an exploding torchstalk take 3 ({@dice 1d6}) fire damage.
numericDifferences.localized: 這種蘑菇高一至兩尺，菌蓋可燃；一株火把菇點燃後可燃燒24小時。點燃時有六分之一的機率爆炸，散成一團燃燒的孢子。爆炸火把菇10尺內的生物受到3（{@dice 1d6}）點火焰傷害。

numericDifferences.english: The drow party consists of Ilvara ({@creature drow priestess of Lolth}), the {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors} Jorlan and Shoor, and the junior priestess {@creature Asha Vandree|OotA} (use the {@creature priest} stat block in the {@i Monster Manual}, but add the Fey Ancestry, Innate Spellcasting, and Sunlight Sensitivity features of the {@creature drow} stat block). The hunting party also includes four {@creature drow} warriors who serve as forward scouts. If any of the drow NPCs did not survive chapter 1, replace them with newly arrived reinforcements from Menzoberranzan under the command of Ilvara, or another priestess of her caliber.
numericDifferences.localized: 卓爾小隊由伊爾瓦拉（{@creature drow priestess of Lolth||卓爾羅絲女祭司}）、兩名{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}喬蘭和肖爾，以及初級女祭司{@creature Asha Vandree|OotA|阿莎·範德里}（使用{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的{@creature priest||祭司}屬性塊，但新增{@creature drow||卓爾}屬性塊中的妖精血脈、天生施法和陽光敏感受性特性）組成。狩獵隊還包括四名作為前方偵察兵的{@creature drow||卓爾}戰士。如果任何卓爾NPC在第一章中未能倖存，用新到來的來自魔索布萊城的由伊爾瓦拉或其他同等級女祭司指揮的增援部隊替換他們。

numericDifferences.english: The drow try to capture the escaped prisoners if at all possible, since Ilvara wants the pleasure of teaching them a lesson about disobedience. If the dark elves reduce any characters to 0 hit points, those characters are knocked out rather than dying (see "{@book Knocking a Creature Out|PHB|9|Knocking a Creature Out}" in chapter 9 of the {@i Player's Handbook}). Even if one or more of the characters are accidentally killed, Ilvara is obsessed enough to cast {@spell raise dead} to restore them to life (assuming the character's soul is willing to return).
numericDifferences.localized: 卓爾精靈會儘可能地嘗試抓捕逃犯，因為伊爾瓦拉想要享受教訓他們不服從的樂趣。如果黑暗精靈將任何角色生命值降至0，那些角色會被擊暈而非死亡（參見{@book 擊暈|PHB|9|Knocking a Creature Out}，在{@i 玩家手冊}第九章）。即使一個或多個角色意外死亡，伊爾瓦拉也會執著到施放{@spell raise dead||死者復活}來將他們復生（假設角色的靈魂願意迴歸）。

numericDifferences.english: A lit torch or its equivalent uses up air as a character does. Briefer but hotter magical effects consume 1 hour of air per die of fire damage per round. For example, a {@spell fireball} spell that deals {@dice 8d6} fire damage consumes 8 hours of air, while a {@spell fire bolt} that deals {@dice 1d10} fire damage consumes 1 hour of air per use.
numericDifferences.localized: 點燃的火把或其等效物會像角色一樣消耗空氣。短暫但更熱的魔法效果每輪消耗等同於火傷害骰數的小時數。例如，造成{@dice 8d6}火傷害的{@spell fireball||火球術}法術會消耗8小時的空氣，而造成{@dice 1d10}火傷害的{@spell fire bolt||火焰箭}法術每次使用會消耗1小時的空氣。

numericDifferences.english: Each door in the tomb is a 10-foot-by-10-foot slab of solid marble encased in a thin layer of beaten bronze. The bronze has turned green with age. The door pivots on a central axis, creating narrow openings on either side while open. The door is also heavy and tight-fitting, requiring a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to open or close.
numericDifferences.localized: 墳墓中的每一扇門都是一個10尺見方的實心大理石板，外層包裹著一層薄薄的鍛青銅。青銅因年代久遠而變成了綠色。這扇門以中央軸為支點旋轉，開啟時兩側會形成狹窄的開口。門非常沉重且緊貼門框，需要投擲{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來開啟或關閉。

numericDifferences.english: On round 3 of the fight, characters notice kuo-toa crying out and flailing in the shallows of the Darklake. Several are pulled under or strike at unseen foes beneath the surface. The water foams red with blood.
numericDifferences.localized: 在戰鬥的第三回合，角色們注意到寇濤魚人在黑暗湖的淺水區中呼喊並掙扎。一些寇濤魚人被拉到水下或攻擊看不見的敵人。湖水因鮮血而泛起泡沫。

numericDifferences.english: A creature with one or more levels of {@condition exhaustion} brought on by grackle-lung must succeed on a Constitution check to take the {@action Dash} action. If the check fails, the action cannot be attempted. If the creature attempts to cast a spell with a verbal component, it must succeed on a Constitution check or be unable to complete the spell, causing the spell to fail with no effect. The DC for each check is 10 + the creature's current {@condition exhaustion} level.
numericDifferences.localized: 由於鴉肺病引起的1級或多級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}的生物必須透過一次體質檢定才能採取{@action Dash||疾走}行動。如果檢定失敗，則無法嘗試該行動。如果生物試圖施放需要口頭成分的法術，它必須透過一次體質檢定，否則無法完成法術，導致法術失敗且無效果。每次檢定的難度等級為10加上生物當前的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等級。

numericDifferences.english: The vision ends when the ceremony does, after which the creatures file solemnly back to Yggmorgus. Characters witnessing the wedding rehearsal and the accompanying vision must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2).
numericDifferences.localized: 這個幻象在儀式結束時消失，之後這些生物莊嚴地返回伊格摩格斯。目睹婚禮彩排及伴隨幻象的角色必須成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 感知豁免檢定，否則會獲得一級瘋狂（見第二章中的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"）。

numericDifferences.english: Among the party's fellow escapees, the deep gnome {@creature Jimjar|OotA} is the most enthusiastic about visiting Blingdenstone, and he can lead the adventurers there. {@creature Topsy|OotA} and {@creature Turvy|OotA} also know the way, but they are noticeably less willing to go to the settlement because of the fear and shame they feel regarding their lycanthropic affliction. The shield dwarf scout {@creature Eldeth Feldrun|OotA} isn't sure how to reach the gnome settlement, but is in favor of going there if it offers a route to the surface or to Gauntlgrym. If the characters allow {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} (the sentient gelatinous cube from "{@area The Oozing Temple|0ca|x}" in chapter 2) to accompany them, it feels a certain pull toward Blingdenstone, and is curious enough to guide the characters there.
numericDifferences.localized: 在隊伍的逃亡者中，地底侏儒{@creature Jimjar|OotA|吉姆加爾}最熱衷於訪問布靈登石，他可以帶領冒險者們前往那裡。{@creature Topsy|OotA|托普西}和{@creature Turvy|OotA|托芮}也知道路，但由於他們對於自己的狼人疾病感到恐懼和羞恥，他們明顯不太願意去這個定居點。盾矮人偵察兵{@creature Eldeth Feldrun|OotA|埃德斯．費爾德倫}不確定如何到達侏儒定居點，但如果那裡提供了通往地面或高爾特格林的路線，他支援去那裡。如果角色們允許{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}（來自第二章中的"{@area 流動的神廟|0ca|x}"的有感知能力的凝膠立方體）陪同他們，它對布靈登石有一種特定的吸引力，並且足夠好奇，可以引導角色們前往那裡。

numericDifferences.english: The party's drow pursuers won't attempt to follow the characters into Blingdenstone. The party's pursuit level (see "{@area Drow Pursuit|078|x}" in chapter 2) doesn't change while they are in the svirfneblin settlement.
numericDifferences.localized: 隊伍的卓爾族追擊者不會試圖跟隨角色進入布靈登石。當他們在斯涅布力定居點時，隊伍的追擊等級（參見第二章中的'{@area 黑暗精靈追擊|078|x}'）不會改變。

numericDifferences.english: If the party's pursuit level is 3 or higher when they arrive at Blingdenstone, Ilvara and her party are watching the tunnels leaving the settlement. The pursuit level increases to 5 when the characters leave Blingdenstone, possibly leading to a chase or straight into chapter 7, "{@adventure Escape From the Underdark|OotA|6}."
numericDifferences.localized: 如果隊伍到達布靈登石時的追擊等級為3或更高，伊爾瓦拉和她的隊伍會監視著離開定居點的隧道。當角色們離開布靈登石時，追擊等級提升至5，可能會導致追逐或直接進入第七章，'{@adventure 逃離幽暗地域|OotA|6}'。

numericDifferences.english: The characters approach a section of Blingdenstone in horrible disrepair. If they explore the area, roll a {@dice d6} and consult the Dungeon Hazards table to determine what the characters encounter. See "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for more information on each hazard.
numericDifferences.localized: 角色們來到了布林登石城一處破敗不堪的區域。如果他們探索這片區域，擲一個{@dice d6}並參考地城災害表以確定他們遭遇的情況。更多關於每種災害的資訊，請參閱{@i 城主指南}第五章中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}"。

numericDifferences.english: 1/day each: {@spell blindness/deafness}, {@spell blur}, {@spell disguise self}
numericDifferences.localized: 每天一次：{@spell blindness/deafness||目盲術/耳聾術}，{@spell blur||朦朧術}，{@spell disguise self||易容術}

numericDifferences.english: At the north end of the tunnel is a smaller door made of stone reinforced with adamantine (see the "Doors of Blingdenstone" sidebar). Fifteen-foot-high ledges in alcoves flank the door. The ledges are currently unguarded, and the stone door opens easily to reveal the caves of Inner Blingdenstone beyond.
numericDifferences.localized: 隧道北端有一扇較小的門，由石料加固精金製成（見"布靈登石的門"邊欄）。門兩側的凹室中設有15尺高的壁架。壁架目前無人守衛，石門輕易開啟，顯露出布靈登石內部的洞穴。

numericDifferences.english: Gurnik warns them that once they place the gem, Ogrémoch's Bane will send its servants to stop them. They must defeat these servants until the gem awakens three temple guardians, at which point the temple will be cleansed and the characters can leave. Once the characters accomplish this task, Gurnik channels the power of the cleansed temple, bestowing a {@reward blessing of protection} or a {@reward blessing of weapon enhancement} on each of the characters (each player's choice); see "{@book Other Rewards|DMG|7|Other Rewards}" in chapter 7 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for more information on blessings.
numericDifferences.localized: 加尼克警告它們一旦他們將寶石放置在指定地點，奧格莫克的禍根會派遣它的僕人來阻止他們。他們必須擊敗這些僕人直到寶石喚醒三個廟宇護衛，屆時廟宇將被淨化且角色們可以離開。一旦角色們完成這個任務，加尼克會引導淨化廟宇的法力，給予每個角色一個{@reward blessing of protection||護佑祝福}或一個{@reward blessing of weapon enhancement||神兵祝福}(每個玩家的選擇)；詳見{@book 其他獎勵|DMG|7|Other Rewards}中第七章的{@i 城主指南}獲取更多關於祝福的訊息。

numericDifferences.english: The wererats have rigged traps throughout the warrens. All wererats know where the traps are and how to avoid them. The traps are marked with russet squares on the map. The first time a party member enters one of these areas, he or she triggers a trap unless the trap has been detected and disarmed. Roll a {@dice d6} to determine the type of trap: 1–2, spiked pit (10 feet deep and lined with zurkhwood spikes); 3–4, collapsing roof; or 5–6, poison darts. See "{@book Sample Traps|DMG|5|Sample Traps}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for information on each trap.
numericDifferences.localized: 鼠人在地道中設定了陷阱。所有鼠人都知道陷阱的位置以及如何避開它們。陷阱在地圖上用赤褐色的方塊標記。第一次有隊員進入這些區域時，除非陷阱被探測並解除，否則他或她將觸發陷阱。擲一枚{@dice d6}來確定陷阱的型別：1-2，尖刺陷坑（深10尺，底部佈滿祖克木尖刺）；3-4，坍塌的屋頂；或5-6，毒箭。關於每個陷阱的詳細資訊，請參閱{@i 城主指南}第五章中的"{@book 陷阱範例|DMG|5|Sample Traps}"。

numericDifferences.english: To play out these meetings, use the social interaction rules provided in chapter 8, "{@book Running the Game|DMG|8}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}. Some representatives are fine with meeting the adventurers in the Vault of Kings, but you might have others request a private or even clandestine meeting—perhaps in the characters' quarters, in an out-of-the-way alcove of the Iron Tabernacle, or in the Great Forge.
numericDifferences.localized: 為了進行這些會面，請使用第八章 "{@book 運作遊戲|DMG|8}" 中提供的社會互動規則，該規則來自 {@i 城主指南}。一些代表願意在國王的穹頂大廳與冒險者會面，但也可能有其他代表要求私下甚至秘密的會面——或許是在角色的住所、鋼鐵聖所中偏僻的角落，或者在大鍛造爐中。

numericDifferences.english: Huddled against a stone column at the edge of the fungi grove is a cowardly {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome} named Flink. He suffers from a form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) that makes him want to please his mistress, Yantha Coaxrock, and also causes him to be deathly afraid of her. He uses his Stone Camouflage feature to blend in with the rocky terrain, afraid that the drow and the gargoyles might attack him. If he sees the characters, he runs toward them in a panic, babbling about a stolen gem. A successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation} or {@skill Persuasion}) check or {@spell calm emotions} spell allows Flink to speak coherently, whereupon he reveals the following information:
numericDifferences.localized: 蜷縮在真菌林邊緣一根石柱旁的是一個名叫弗林克的膽小 {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}。他患有一種不確定的瘋狂形式（參見 {@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}，位於 {@i 城主指南} 第八章），這讓他想要取悅他的女主人揚莎·寇克斯洛克，同時也讓他對她極度恐懼。他利用他的石膚偽裝特性與岩石地形融為一體，害怕卓爾精靈和石像鬼可能會攻擊他。如果他看到角色們，他會驚慌失措地向他們跑去，語無倫次地提及一顆被盜的寶石。成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇} 或 {@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定或 {@spell calm emotions||安定心神} 法術能讓弗林克有條理地說話，此時他會透露以下資訊：

numericDifferences.english: Having the adventurers leading an expanded party gives you the opportunity to use the optional loyalty rules in chapter 4, "{@book Creating Nonplayer Characters|DMG|4|Optional Rule: Loyalty}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}. You can track the loyalty scores of groups of NPCs, such as those belonging to each faction, rather than having to track NPCs individually. The characters must balance the goals and bonds of their followers in order to maintain and improve their loyalty.
numericDifferences.localized: 讓冒險者們帶領一支擴大的隊伍為你提供了使用第四章中可選忠誠規則的機會，該章節名為"{@book 建立非玩家角色|DMG|4|Optional Rule: Loyalty}"，來自{@i 城主指南}。你可以跟蹤一群NPC的忠誠分數，例如屬於每個派系的NPC，而不必單獨跟蹤每個NPC。角色們必須平衡其追隨者的目標和羈絆，以維持並提高他們的忠誠度。

numericDifferences.english: If the expeditionary force needs to supplement or replace supplies while traveling, the amounts that characters are able to find become more important with a larger group to support. See "{@book Foraging|DMG|5|Foraging}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}, as well as the guidelines in {@area chapter 2|067|x} of this adventure.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果遠徵軍在旅途中需要補充或替換物資，那麼在支援更大團隊的情況下，角色能夠找到的物資數量就變得更加重要。請參閱{@i 城主指南}第五章中的"{@book 覓食|DMG|5|Foraging}"以及本冒險{@area 第二章|067|x}中的指導方針。

numericDifferences.english: If {@creature Shuushar the Awakened|OotA} (see {@area chapter 1|008|x}) was not killed in a previous chapter of the adventure, the characters find him among Sloobludop's survivors. He is the sole point of calm and reason in the ruined settlement, and the various factions of the kuo-toa show him respect. Shuushar mediates disputes between the kuo-toa and supervises the allocation of their dwindling resources. Even so, the kuo-toa monk isn't sure how long he can sustain his people and keep them from destruction.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果{@creature Shuushar the Awakened|OotA|覺醒者蘇沙爾}（見第1章{@area 第一章|008|x}）在冒險的前幾章中沒有被殺死，角色們會在Sloobludop的生還者中找到他。他是被毀定居點中唯一的平靜和理性之點，而且各種派系的寇濤魚人都對他表現出尊重。Shuushar調解寇濤魚人之間的爭端，並監督他們日益減少的資源分配。即便如此，這位寇濤魚人武僧也不確定他能維持他的人民多久，並防止他們走向毀滅。

numericDifferences.english: The nearest purple worm nesting area mapped out for the characters by {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA} lies forty-eight miles west of the archmage's tower. The Vast Oblivium lies some twelve miles south of this nursery. Use the guidelines in {@area chapters 2|051|x} and {@area 10|397|x} as the party travels through the Underdark, but use the Wormwrithings Encounters table instead of the random encounter tables in chapter 2. Foraging is more difficult in the Wormwrithings, requiring successful {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks.
numericDifferences.localized: 由{@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|維茲蘭·迪威爾}為角色們繪製的最接近的紫色蠕蟲巢穴區域位於大法師之塔以西48英里處。無盡虛無位於這個巢穴以南約12英里處。當隊伍穿越幽暗地域時，使用{@area 第二章|051|x}和{@area 10|397|x}中的指南，但使用蠕蟲扭曲遭遇表代替第2章中的隨機遭遇表。在蠕蟲扭曲區域覓食更加困難，需要成功的{@dc 20}感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。

numericDifferences.english: {@i Faerzress} permeates only the fringes of the Wormwrithings. While the party explores this region of the Underdark, spellcasters won't have to deal with the effects described under "{@area Faerzress|05f|x}" in chapter 2.
numericDifferences.localized: {@i 費爾茲瑞斯} 只滲透到蠕蟲文字的邊緣地帶。當隊伍探索這個幽暗地域的區域時，施法者不需要處理第二章中"{@area 費爾茲瑞斯|05f|x}"所描述的效果。

numericDifferences.english: Nightlights (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2) and other luminous fungi dimly illuminate the caves and tunnels throughout the troglodyte lair.
numericDifferences.localized: 夜光菌（見第二章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）和其他發光真菌微弱地照亮了整個穴蜥人巢穴中的洞穴和隧道。

numericDifferences.english: A thick jet of hot steam spews forth from a crack in the floor near the east wall of this cavern. Growing around the steam vent is a patch of fire lichen (see "{@area Fungi of the Underdark|067|x}" in chapter 2).
numericDifferences.localized: 一股濃厚的熱蒸汽從這個洞穴東牆附近的地面裂縫中噴湧而出。在蒸汽孔周圍生長著一片火地衣（見第二章中的"{@area 幽暗地域的真菌|067|x}"）。

numericDifferences.english: Fifteen minutes after the party enters area 1, a purple worm digs into area 1, then travels through area 3 and creates tunnel T1 to enter area 8.
numericDifferences.localized: 隊伍進入區域1後15分鐘，一條紫蟲挖掘進入區域1，然後穿過區域3，並建立隧道T1進入區域8。

numericDifferences.english: Ten minutes after the first worm arrives, a second purple worm enters through the tunnel in area 7. It makes its way through the adjoining echo chamber, then into area 8. Then it digs tunnel T2 into the eastern echo chamber before exiting through the worm tunnel in area 14.
numericDifferences.localized: 第一條蠕蟲到達後10分鐘，第二條紫蟲透過區域7的隧道進入。它穿過相鄰的迴音室，然後進入區域8。然後它挖掘隧道T2進入東側的迴音室，再透過區域14的蠕蟲隧道離開。

numericDifferences.english: Fifteen minutes after the second worm arrives, another purple worm enters through the tunnel in area 7, digs tunnel T3 from the southern echo chamber into the eastern echo chamber, then exits through the worm tunnel in area 14.
numericDifferences.localized: 第二條蠕蟲到達後的15分鐘，又有一條紫蟲透過區域7的隧道進入，從南邊的迴音室挖掘隧道T3進入東側的迴音室，然後透過區域14的蠕蟲隧道離開。

numericDifferences.english: The tunnel marked T1 on the map doesn't exist until a purple worm creates it fifteen minutes after the party discovers area 1 (see the "{@area Worm Nursery: General Features|464|x}" sidebar). Thus, the characters won't be able to reach area 8 until the tunnel is formed.
numericDifferences.localized: 地圖上標記為T1的隧道在紫蟲在隊伍發現區域1後的15分鐘內創造它之前並不存在（見"{@area 蠕蟲託兒所：一般特徵|464|x}"側邊欄）。因此，直到隧道形成後，角色們才能夠到達區域8。

numericDifferences.english: This 30-foot-high unlit cavern has a twenty-foot-wide pit in its center, which descends a thousand feet. Thirty feet down is a small ledge holding the skeletal remains of a moon elf adventurer clad in moldering leather armor.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個30尺高的未照明洞穴中心有一個20尺寬的坑，深達一千尺。在下方30尺處有一個小平臺，上面有一個月精靈冒險家的骨骼殘骸，他穿著破舊的皮甲。

numericDifferences.english: A chasm cuts across this cavern, stretching from wall to wall. The chasm is 10 feet wide, 200 feet deep, and slopes down to the southwest at a sixty degree angle. The chasm's slope can be climbed with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A creature that fails the check by 5 or more goes tumbling down the slop to the bottom of the chasm, taking damage from the fall as normal.
numericDifferences.localized: 一道深淵橫穿這個洞穴，從一面牆延伸到另一面牆。深淵寬10尺，深200尺，向西南方向以60度角傾斜。深淵的斜坡可以透過一個成功的{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定攀爬。檢定失敗且差值超過5的生物會沿著斜坡翻滾到深淵底部，並如常承受墜落傷害。

numericDifferences.english: Twenty minutes after the characters first enter the purple worm nursery through area 1, Zhora and her Dark Hunters enter these caverns through the tunnel in area 7, then scale down to the cavern floor. They spend a few minutes regrouping and making their way through the southern echo chamber, then arrive in area 8 and scale the resin strands to grab two purple worm eggs. If they encounter the adventurers and Hanne isn't present, the drow are hostile, though they might be convinced to enter a temporary truce with a successful {@dc 20} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check.
numericDifferences.localized: 角色首次透過區域1進入紫色蠕蟲培育室20分鐘後，卓拉和她的黑暗獵手們透過區域7的隧道進入這些洞穴，然後下降到洞穴地面。他們花費幾分鐘時間重新集結並穿過南部回聲室，隨後到達區域8，並攀爬樹脂絲以獲取兩顆紫色蠕蟲卵。如果他們遇到冒險者且漢內不在場，這些卓爾精靈將會敵對，但如果成功透過一次{@dc 20}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，他們可能會被說服達成暫時休戰。

numericDifferences.english: If the characters reunite Zhora and Hanne, this act of benevolence could lead to Zhora potentially aiding the adventurers in chapter 15, "{@adventure The City of Spiders|OotA|14}." See that chapter for details.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果角色們讓卓拉和漢娜團聚，這一仁慈的行為可能會使卓拉在第十五章'{@adventure 蜘蛛之城|OotA|14}'中潛在地幫助冒險者。詳情見該章節。

numericDifferences.english: Characters in the Labyrinth can easily become lost. Traveling through this area follows the rules under "{@area Navigating|05a|x}" in chapter 2, but it takes a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check to avoid becoming lost, rather than a {@dc 10} check. Spellcasters must contend with the effects of the {@i faerzress} for as long as they are in the Labyrinth, also as discussed in {@area chapter 2|05f|x}.
numericDifferences.localized: 迷宮中的人物容易迷失方向。穿越此區域遵循第2章"{@area 導航|05a|x}"下的規則，但需要透過一次成功的{@dc 12}感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定來避免迷路，而不是{@dc 10}檢定。施法者在迷宮內時必須應對{@i 費爾茲瑞斯}的影響，如第2章{@area 第二章|05f|x}所述。

numericDifferences.english: No ordinary structure, the tower is a {@item Daern's instant fortress} (see chapter 7, "{@book Treasure|DMG|7}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). Made entirely of adamantine, the two-story tower has remained sealed since its last owner retreated inside and locked the door behind her—but not before a pair of shadow demons slipped in as well. The demons killed the owner and left her remains on the first floor. The tower can't be tipped over or otherwise moved from its position, and the arrow slits on each level are too narrow for anything bigger than a Tiny creature to squeeze through.
numericDifferences.localized: 這並非普通的建築，這座塔是一件{@item Daern's instant fortress||迪恩的摺疊要塞}（參見{@i 城主指南}第七章"{@book 寶藏|DMG|7}"）。這座兩層塔完全由精金打造，自從它的最後一位主人退入其中並鎖上門後，塔就保持封閉狀態——但在此之前，一對影魔也悄悄溜了進去。影魔殺死了主人，並將她的遺骸留在了一樓。這座塔無法被推倒或以其他方式從其位置移動，且每層的箭縫過於狹窄，任何比微型生物更大的東西都無法擠過。

numericDifferences.english: Any adventurer witnessing this horrible tableau must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2). If this causes the character to suffer a bout of indefinite madness, determine the nature of the madness using the Madness of Yeenoghu table in {@adventure appendix D|OotA|20}.
numericDifferences.localized: 任何目睹這一可怕場景的冒險者必須成功進行一次 {@dc 12} 感知豁免檢定，否則將獲得一個瘋狂等級（參見第二章中的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"）。如果這導致角色遭受一次不定性瘋狂的發作，請使用 {@adventure 附錄D|OotA|20} 中的耶諾古瘋狂表來確定瘋狂的性質。

numericDifferences.english: This angel points at a spot on the cavern wall, and its mouth hangs open in horror. A character who makes contact with the angel hears horrific screaming and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2).
numericDifferences.localized: 這位天使指向洞穴牆壁上的一個點，它的嘴因恐懼而張開。與天使接觸的角色會聽到可怕的尖叫聲，必須成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 的感知豁免檢定，否則會獲得一級瘋狂狀態（見第二章中的"{@area 瘋狂|063|x}"）。

numericDifferences.english: Located forty-eight miles southeast of the Gallery of Angels, the Maze Engine is wedged halfway down a 20-foot-wide, 100-foot-deep crevasse located in the middle of a large cavern. The bottom of the crevasse is filled with magma. A shimmering curtain of heat rises from the crevasse and makes the cavern hot and dry.
numericDifferences.localized: 迷宮引擎位於天使畫廊東南方向48英里處，被卡在一個位於大型洞穴中央的20尺寬、100尺深的裂縫中段。裂縫底部充滿了巖漿。從裂縫中升起的閃爍熱幕使得洞穴變得炎熱乾燥。

numericDifferences.english: On the round after the Maze Engine activates, two {@creature Magma Mephit||magma mephits} fly out of the magma on initiative count 10. Two more {@creature Magma Mephit||magma mephits} emerge from the magma each round thereafter on the same initiative count, until a dozen mephits have appeared. The mephits attack anyone on or near the Maze Engine.
numericDifferences.localized: 在迷宮引擎啟用後的輪次，兩個{@creature Magma Mephit||熔岩魔蝠}在先制計數10時從巖漿中飛出。在此之後的每輪，同樣在先制計數10時，會再有兩隻{@creature Magma Mephit||熔岩魔蝠}從巖漿中出現，直到出現了一打小鬼。這些小鬼會攻擊任何在迷宮引擎附近或上面的人。

numericDifferences.english: If a creature falls from the Maze Engine, another creature adjacent to the falling creature and hanging onto one of the engine's bands can attempt to use a free hand to grab the falling creature, doing so with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw. A creature saved in this manner can use its action to try to climb back onto the engine, doing so with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. If the check fails and the creature's weight exceeds the carrying capacity of the creature that grabbed it (see "{@book Lifting and Carrying|PHB|7|Lifting and Carrying}" in chapter 7 of the {@i Player's Handbook}), the creature grabbing it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength check at the start of its next turn or lose its grip on the fallen creature, which then plunges into the magma.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果一個生物從迷宮引擎上跌落，另一個鄰近跌落生物並抓住引擎某一帶的生物可以嘗試用一隻空手抓住跌落生物，這需要一個成功的 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免。以這種方式被救起的生物可以使用其動作嘗試攀爬回引擎，這需要一個成功的 {@dc 13} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。如果檢定失敗並且生物的體重超過了抓住它的生物的承載能力（參見 {@i 玩家手冊} 第七章中的 "{@book 抬舉與載重|PHB|7|Lifting and Carrying}"），抓住它的生物必須在其下一回合開始時成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 力量檢定，否則失去對跌落生物的抓握，後者將墜入巖漿中。

numericDifferences.english: The drow's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC equal to 10 + the drow's Charisma modifier). The drow can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: {@spell dancing lights} 1/day each: {@spell darkness}, {@spell faerie fire}, {@spell levitate} (self only)
numericDifferences.localized: 黑暗精靈天生的施法能力是魅力（法術豁免DC等於10加上黑暗精靈的魅力調整值）。黑暗精靈天生能夠無需材料元件施放以下法術：隨時：{@spell dancing lights||舞光術} 每天一次：{@spell darkness||黑暗術}，{@spell faerie fire||妖火}，{@spell levitate||浮空術}（僅自身）

numericDifferences.english: This {@creature drow commoner|OotA} suffers from a form of indefinite madness (see "{@area Madness|063|x}" in chapter 2 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). The drow believes he or she is the true voice of Lolth, tasked by the Demon Queen of Spiders to admonish everyone for their lack of devotion, warning that "Demons will consume you all!" The mad drow wears an amulet made from a dead spider.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個{@creature drow commoner|OotA|卓爾平民}患有一種永久性瘋狂（參見{@area 瘋狂|063|x}，位於{@i 城主指南}第二章）。這名卓爾相信自己就是羅絲的真實聲音，被蜘蛛惡魔女王委派來譴責所有人缺乏奉獻精神，並警告說"惡魔會吞噬你們所有人！"這名瘋狂的黑暗精靈佩戴著一個由死蜘蛛製成的護符。

numericDifferences.english: Fungal life fills the caverns and passageways in the region, with visitors literally walking upon and within Araumycos upon entering its domain. The floor is carpeted with thick mold and fungus, creating patches of {@quickref difficult terrain||3} throughout. In some tunnels and caves, fungi growths obstruct passage. Characters either have to climb or hack their way through the fungal growth. In other places, the fungus covering the floor is soft enough that characters can sink into it with no warning. Use the quicksand rules in chapter 5, "{@book Adventure Environments|DMG|5|Quicksand}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for such areas. Creatures that fail to escape become food for Araumycos.
numericDifferences.localized: 真菌生命充滿了該區域的洞穴和通道，訪客在進入其領域時實際上是走在阿勞麥柯之上和其中。地面上鋪滿了厚厚的黴菌和真菌，形成了遍佈的{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。在一些隧道和洞穴中，真菌的生長阻礙了通行。角色們要麼需要攀爬，要麼得砍出一條穿過真菌生長的路。在其他地方，覆蓋地面的真菌柔軟到足以讓角色不知不覺地陷入其中。使用第五章"{@book 冒險環境|DMG|5|Quicksand}"中的{@i 城主指南}中的流沙規則來處理這些區域。未能逃脫的生物將成為阿勞麥柯的食物。

numericDifferences.english: In addition to (or instead of) providing information to the adventurers, the last connection to the surviving Araumycos can bestow a {@reward charm of heroism} to all the player characters (see "{@book Other Rewards|DMG|7|Other Rewards}" in chapter 7 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
numericDifferences.localized: 除了（或代替）向冒險者們提供訊息外，與倖存的阿勞麥柯的最後聯絡可以授予所有玩家角色一個{@reward charm of heroism||英勇護咒}（參見{@i 城主指南}第七章中的"{@book 其他獎勵|DMG|7|Other Rewards}"）。

chapterCounts.name: 第8章：在岡特格瑞姆的覲見
